test_item:
DebugAuth shall check SAM certificate as part of AuthData verification.
(SAM certificate is x509 PEM, anchors to the OEM issued root, and carries the SAM subject)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk is installed
3. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
4. An AuthData package is available on a USB drive
proc:
1. Read the SAM certificate format and subject on the host
$ openssl x509 -in SAMcert.pem -text
2. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the SAM certificate against the OEM issued root certificate
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
3. Run the Cert Provider instrumentation test for the SAM certificate normal flow
$ adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test.CertProviderServiceManagerTest#samCertTestNormalFlow com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
er:
1. The openssl x509 output shows the certificate in x509 PEM format and a "Subject:" line intended for SAM and specific market
2. The openssl command prints "SAMcert.pem: OK" on stdout
3. The instrumentation runner reports "OK (1 test)" for samCertTestNormalFlow

author: PeiPYHsu
